faction.astral-town.astral.name: Astral
hero.astral-town.adonus.biography: Adonus learned to read the currents of steam in the old bathhouses of Astral. When the restless vapors began answering his commands, he left the city's workshops to serve the elemental cause.
hero.astral-town.adonus.name: Adonus
hero.astral-town.adonus.specialty.descri: Increases Speed of any Steam Elementals or Smoke Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.astral-town.adonus.specialty.name: Steam Elementals
hero.astral-town.artemis.biography: Artemis was once a trail guide on the sun-scorched borders of Astral. Her patient eye and unerring aim made her the natural leader of the Deserted Shooters who now guard those lonely roads.
hero.astral-town.artemis.name: Artemis
hero.astral-town.artemis.specialty.descr: Increases Speed of any Deserted Shooters or Deserted Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.astral-town.artemis.specialty.name: Deserted Shooters
hero.astral-town.corinthya.biography: Corinthya earned the respect of the Dao by settling disputes no mortal court could judge. Their oaths of service brought her to Astral, where she tempers elemental fury with wisdom and restraint.
hero.astral-town.corinthya.name: Corinthya
hero.astral-town.corinthya.specialty.des: Increases Speed of any Dao or Dao Khans by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.astral-town.drugar.biography: Fashioned in a royal alchemical crucible, Drugar was dismissed as a costly mistake. He escaped the laboratory with a talent for finding gold wherever earth and magic meet.
hero.astral-town.drugar.name: Drugar
hero.astral-town.drugar.specialty.descri: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.astral-town.drugar.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.astral-town.gavinus.biography: Gavinus has spent a lifetime turning rival captains into allies. His calm voice and knowledge of elemental customs allow Astral to welcome soldiers who might otherwise stand against it.
hero.astral-town.gavinus.name: Gavinus
hero.astral-town.gavinus.specialty.name: Diplomacy
hero.astral-town.jaeron.biography: Jaeron studied the mineral veins beneath Astral until he could hear stone shifting in the dark. He now shapes that patient strength into wards that shelter his companions from harm.
hero.astral-town.jaeron.name: Jaeron
hero.astral-town.jaeron.specialty.descri: Casts Stone Skin with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.astral-town.jaeron.specialty.name: Stone Skin
hero.astral-town.klaus.biography: Klaus served as a caravan guard before a storm elemental saved his company from raiders. Since then, he has carried the art of protection to Astral's most exposed frontiers.
hero.astral-town.klaus.name: Klaus
hero.astral-town.klaus.specialty.descrip: Casts Shield with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.astral-town.klaus.specialty.name: Shield
hero.astral-town.laurus.biography: Laurus forged armor for the first defenders of Astral, blending tempered steel with dust from the elemental altars. He joined the field ranks to prove that every shield can become a bulwark.
hero.astral-town.laurus.name: Laurus
hero.astral-town.laurus.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.astral-town.laurus.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.astral-town.lavinius.biography: Lavinius follows the sulfur springs that thread through Astral's volcanic foothills. His careful stewardship keeps the town's furnaces burning and its elemental rites supplied.
hero.astral-town.lavinius.name: Lavinius
hero.astral-town.lavinius.specialty.desc: Increases kingdom's sulfur production by 1 per day.
hero.astral-town.lavinius.specialty.name: +1 Sulfur
hero.astral-town.maesie.biography: Maesie is a swift-moving scout who studies the moment when fear becomes fury. She leads Astral's skirmishers through broken ground, then turns a foe's confusion into a decisive rout.
hero.astral-town.maesie.name: Maesie
hero.astral-town.maesie.specialty.descri: Creatures under Berserk do more damage, depending on relation between Maesie's level and creature's level.
hero.astral-town.maesie.specialty.name: Berserk
hero.astral-town.nadine.biography: Nadine was raised among the ash dunes west of Astral, where wind can uncover a city overnight. Her bond with dust and ash elementals makes her an invaluable guide through the shifting wastes.
hero.astral-town.nadine.name: Nadine
hero.astral-town.nadine.specialty.descri: Increases Speed of any Dust Elementals or Ash Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.astral-town.nadine.specialty.name: Dust Elementals
hero.astral-town.naegarhan.biography: Naegarhan sought the hidden harmonies between the four elements long before Astral was founded. His experiments are daring, but his command of raw magic has saved the town more than once.
hero.astral-town.naegarhan.name: Naegarhan
hero.astral-town.naegarhan.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.astral-town.rosalynn.biography: Rosalynn chased lightning across the high mesas as a child and learned to welcome its thunder. The Radiance Elementals answer her call with the same fierce brilliance.
hero.astral-town.rosalynn.name: Rosalynn
hero.astral-town.rosalynn.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Lightning Elementals or Radiance Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.astral-town.rosalynn.specialty.name: Lightning Elementals
hero.astral-town.samuel.biography: Samuel mapped Astral's forgotten wells and storm paths before he ever commanded an army. His keen eyes now keep its explorers one step ahead of danger.
hero.astral-town.samuel.name: Samuel
hero.astral-town.samuel.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Scouting skill percentage.
hero.astral-town.samuel.specialty.name: Scouting
hero.astral-town.shireen.biography: Shireen was trained by messengers who crossed Astral's desert in the time between two heartbeats. Her magic carries that same urgency, sending allies into motion before enemies can react.
hero.astral-town.shireen.name: Shireen
hero.astral-town.shireen.specialty.descr: Casts Haste with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.astral-town.shireen.specialty.name: Haste
hero.astral-town.yurian.biography: Yurian guards a library of elemental charts gathered from every corner of the realm. He believes knowledge is the fifth element, and uses it to make Astral's magic endure.
hero.astral-town.yurian.name: Yurian
hero.astral-town.yurian.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
hero.astral-town.yurian.specialty.name: Intelligence
heroClass.astral-town.stIlluminate.name: Illuminate
heroClass.astral-town.stPadishah.name: Padishah
